The Compiled Inner Fit

Source: R/engine.R
engine_inner_fit.Rd

engine_inner_fit() runs the inner penalized fit of fit_smooth() in compiled code (src/engine_iwls.cpp) when every component of the model has a compiled route, and returns NULL otherwise, in which case fit_smooth() calls iwls_fit(). The compiled fit performs the operations of iwls_fit() in the same order, with the families and links read through the registries of distributions7 and linkfunctions7. engine_route() decides whether a model is covered and assembles the inputs.

Usage

engine_inner_fit(
  spec,
  design,
  obj,
  beta,
  hyper,
  method,
  groups,
  frozen,
  verbose,
  damp_on_reject,
  guard,
  idx = NULL
)

engine_route(spec, design, obj, beta, hyper, method)

engine_model(spec, design, coef, hyper, how)

engine_penalty_units(spec, design, units, hyper)

engine_kink_unit(pen, th, index, mp)

engine_matrix(x)

Arguments

spec, design, obj, hyper

As in fit_smooth().

beta

The full starting vector, with the held values written in.

method

A settled iwls().

groups, frozen

As fit_smooth() passes them to iwls_fit().

verbose

Whether to print the iterations.

damp_on_reject, guard

As in iwls_fit().

idx

NULL for the whole vector, or the positions of the block that fit_smooth() fits with the others held, on the assembled route that subset_pieces() takes.

coef

The coefficients, split by distribution parameter.

how

The solver of the inner fit, "qr", "svd" or "chol", which decides whether the square root of the penalty is formed.

units

The penalized units, statmod_penalized().

pen, th, index, mp

A penalized unit's penalty, its hyperparameters, its stacked positions and its map.

x

A base matrix or a Matrix object.

Value

engine_inner_fit(): the list that iwls_fit() returns, or NULL. engine_route(): NULL, or a list with the elements model, pen and method that the compiled fit reads.

Details

A model is covered when spec@engine is "auto"; the method is an iwls() without a criterion whose expected information is the closed form (method = NULL), distributions7::expect_opg(), distributions7::expect_mc() or distributions7::expect_integrate() (the same object for the information and its backup); the block is the whole coefficient vector, with no break-point kink, no moving block and no nonlinear curvature unit; the family is a univariate family of the registry without a wrapper and every link has a compiled route; no term carries a structural state, a Jeffreys penalty or a mixed penalty unit; and every penalized unit is one that engine_penalty_units() describes.

Where the R route would signal an error the compiled fit stops and engine_inner_fit() returns NULL, so that iwls_fit() reproduces it. With distributions7::expect_mc() the random stream is then restored to its state before the compiled fit, so that iwls_fit() makes the same draws as when it runs alone.

engine_model() returns the data of the model as the compiled routes read them, list(model, pen, covered), or NULL where the model is not covered: the family, its links and the design blocks, and the penalty at hyper (its units, its Hessian and, for the QR and SVD solvers, its square root). covered is the highest derivative order of the family in the registry.

engine_penalty_units() describes each penalized unit to the compiled fit by the quantities that its penalty_value() and penalty_gradient() methods read at the given hyperparameters, so that the compiled value and gradient repeat those methods operation by operation: for a QuadraticPenalty the map, P, penalty_matrix and the three constants; for an AdditivePenalty the summed matrix of additive_sum(), the matrices and their smoothing parameters; for a DistribPenalty with a gaussian prior of fixed mean, the mean and the standard deviation, or, for a multivariate one, the mean, the factor of parameters7::param_factor(), the log-determinant and the inverse covariance. It returns NULL for any other unit.

engine_kink_unit() describes a penalty with a kink to the compiled fit: kind 5 for the lasso (a penalties7::DistribPenalty() whose fixed() parent is a laplace2 at zero), 6 for the elastic net (an enet parent at zero), 7 for penalties7::scad_penalty() and 8 for penalties7::mcp_penalty(), with the diagonal of the map, the rate and the constants of the density, or the curvature. It returns NULL for a penalty without a kink, and FALSE for a kinked one that the compiled fit does not describe (a map that is not diagonal, a block of more than one coordinate, a location other than zero).

engine_matrix() returns a penalty matrix as the compiled fit reads it: a base matrix as it is, any Matrix object as a dgCMatrix, since the R route multiplies by it as a sparse matrix.
